description:
Bedrock pinned {:flatbuffer, "~> 0.3"} (resolving 0.3.1). Upstream is now 0.5.0, which fixes a packaging defect: 0.3.1's tarball shipped the generated src/*.erl leex/yecc output alongside the .xrl/.yrl grammars, so the published parser was whatever the maintainer's local OTP generated rather than a build from the grammars in git. 0.5.0 declares an explicit files: list and ships grammars only.

Bedrock's API surface is a single call site — lib/bedrock/system_keys/cluster_bootstrap.ex:57, 'use Flatbuffer, file: "priv/schemas/cluster_bootstrap.fbs"' — so the upgrade risk is minimal.

Filed upstream as fb-r3l in jallum/flatbuffer; already fixed and closed there.
title: Bump flatbuffer to ~> 0.5
